method: metadata read from the Hugging Face API at the pinned revision — licence, architecture, pooling (1_Pooling/config.json), prompt configuration and file list — not from memory

measurements.consequence: measured for the radar, excluded from the bake-off by the SLO rather than by accuracy

slo_screening.note: D4 rejects a candidate whose projected cold pass exceeds the 4 h SLO, whatever it scores. Measured on the dev host (T-min, 8 physical cores) while the bake-off held most of the CPU, so the rate is pessimistic — but the margin is an order of magnitude, not a factor a free machine would close.
